CAND-03.when_does_it_work: Expanding/rolling sequential windows testing 2023-2025 (post-rate-hike normalization); mid/large-cap liquid names; linear models; LAB-004 absolute-return label
CAND-03.when_does_it_fail: 2022 test year (bear + high volatility + rate-hike stress); nonlinear model families; feature vectors perturbed with ≥5-10% Gaussian noise; execution delayed ≥1 session
CAND-03.gradual_or_catastrophic: MIXED — degradation is gradual for costs/slippage/delay; catastrophic (sign-reversing) under feature corruption and in the 2022 regime
CAND-03.regime_specific: YES — failure concentrates in the single bear/high-vol year (2022)
CAND-03.universe_specific: NO for CAND-03 (consistent across 4 universes); unresolved for CAND-04 (ENV-100 missing)
CAND-03.model_specific: YES — strictly a linear-model phenomenon; tree ensembles reverse sign
CAND-03.single_period_dependence: PARTIAL — not one window (positive in 6/8), but ALL net positive evidence originates in the 2023-2025 sub-period; excluding it leaves the 12D-era null (locked-protocol IC ≈ 0.000-0.011)

candidate_specific.locked_protocol_null_masking: Aggregate 2022-2026 IC (~0.000-0.011) conceals year-level variation uncovered by 13A; effect is period-concentrated

CAND-03.explicit_statement: Failure regions are a successful research output and are reported verbatim; nothing suppressed.
